_doc: Protection code for the CodeAgent arms, subtracted by `loc_count.py --core --no-guard`. Two kinds, mirrored across arms: (a) model-output protection = Verify-phase deterministic guards (written / ran_since_edit / must_have_* invariants and their GUARD notes, WRITE_TOOLS used only by them), router retry / correction / parse-coercion / fallback-to-None, tool-argument coercion and try/except around tool calls, NOOA's verification gate (Checked/check/_gate/EXIT_CODE) and resolved-override; (b) tool-safety guards = path confinement (_abs/safe_path/refuse_path, outside-repo refusals), write protection (_is_test_path BLOCKED, NO_WRITE_DIRS/is_write_blocked, binary-overwrite probe), run_command screening (allow/deny lists, shell metachars, subcommand/flag/path checks, forced+default flags, scrubbed child env), timeouts/kill/poll, output caps and truncation (grep/list caps, MAX_*_CHARS/BYTES, clip/clip_ends, _fill/continuation hints, 12000-char _exec truncation), served-window duplicate-read detection, syntax check after write, near-miss diagnosis. KEPT as core: the phase graph and its repair/relocate cycle (MAX_REPAIRS, repairs counter, repair edge + intents, NOOA `repair` method and run loop) because that cycle is the agent's control flow in all four arms; ReAct iteration caps and TOOL_BUDGET brake (guard()/budget middleware); ordinary tool argument validation (no such file, empty 'old', not-unique match, bad regex, UTF-8 errors); execution backend wrapping and container env. Ranges are [start, end, reason]; `?` marks borderline calls.
